On Wednesday, July 29, 2026, reverse repurchase agreements totaled $337,051 million, of which $334,475 million was held for foreign official and international accounts.

This means foreign official and international accounts made up about **99.2%** ($334,475 ÷ $337,051 million) of the total reverse repurchase agreements outstanding that day, with the remaining ~0.8% ($2,576 million) attributable to "Others."
